text:
eli-fin: Heads up - MediCore raised a billing question on renewal INV-MC-2026-07. They say the partner onboarding credit was applied only to the platform SKU but not amortized across the 12-month support line as agreed in the partner worksheet. AP is asking for a corrected billing schedule.

dana-ar: Can you paste the invoice lines? We need to see how we surfaced the credit on the face of the invoice.

eli-fin: Redacted snippet:
```
Line 1: PLATFORM_ENTERPRISE - $84,000 - SKU PF-MC-ENT-2026
Line 2: PARTNER_ONBOARD_CREDIT - ($12,000) - SKU PF-PART-ONB-CR
Line 3: SUPPORT_TIER_STANDARD - $18,000 - SKU SUP-STD-12M
Total due: $90,000
```
MediCore says the partner worksheet (PW-2025-08-MC) specified the $12k onboarding credit should be amortized as $1k/mo applied against support charges for the first 12 months, not a single negative platform line.

sophia-cs: I remember that amendment. Customer elected amortization during onboarding call. CS logged the worksheet but billing export rules defaulted to emit partner credits as one-off negative platform rows.

omar-sales: I approved the onboarding credit on 2025-08-19 (Approval APPR-2025-2047). The acceptance form explicitly notes amortization over support. We need to make this customer-facing correct ASAP.

dana-ar: AR will not auto-post that invoice because AP expects monthly support reduction entries. Options: 1) reissue invoice splitting the $12k into 12 credits applied to the support line (would change line granularity), 2) issue a schedule/cover letter explaining net amortization with a reference to APPR-2025-2047, or 3) book a credit memo and let AR apply monthly credits in the ledger. Which does billing prefer?

billing-bot: Billing run 2026-07-01 produced invoice INV-MC-2026-07 using rule: partner credits emitted as separate negative platform SKUs. Created ticket BILL-8013 to handle amortization exceptions.

eli-fin: Preference from finance: we'd like the customer-facing invoice to match AP expectations to avoid ACH delays. Ideally reissue a corrected invoice that shows Support line as $17,000 and a sub-line or memo showing the $1,000/month amortization for months 1-12, or present a consolidated single support line with memo "net of amortized partner onboarding credit (APPR-2025-2047)".

sophia-cs: MediCore will accept a corrected invoice that explicitly notes the amortization schedule. They prefer a single corrected invoice plus a PDF amortization schedule attached for their AP.

dana-ar: Action items: 1) @billing-ops (BILL-8013) please prepare a reissued invoice INV-MC-2026-07_R1 with consolidated support wording and attached amortization schedule, 2) @omar-sales please attach APPR-2025-2047 approval PDF to the ticket, 3) AR to hold cash application until corrected invoice is posted.

billing-bot: BILL-8013 assigned to @billing-ops. ETA reissue: 2 business days. Will include memo "See APPR-2025-2047; onboarding credit amortized $1,000/mo months 1-12" and attach amortization PDF.

omar-sales: Uploaded APPR-2025-2047 to the sales folder and linked to the billing ticket.

dana-ar: Thanks. Once billing reissues, I'll notify MediCore AP and confirm they can proceed with payment. If they still need monthly credit memos instead of a single corrected invoice, we can issue monthly credit memos starting next billing cycle.

eli-fin: Please keep this thread updated when BILL-8013 is closed. Goal: avoid cash delay and ensure revenue recognition is correct for support amortization.

billing-bot: BILL-8013 status: in progress. Estimated close 2026-07-05.
